steps: Start a run and fight through Tartarus chambers until you defeat the Fury (Megaera / Alecto / Tisiphone).
Clearing Tartarus unlocks the exit to Asphodel.
Reach Asphodel after Tartarus, then clear its chambers and defeat the Hydra (Lernie).
The exit boat takes you to Elysium.

achievements.name: Arms Collector
achievements.description: Unlock each of the Infernal Arms

steps: Buy each Infernal Arm from the House Contractor courtyard weapon stands (Darkness / keys as required).
Unlock Stygius, Varatha, Aegis, Coronacht, Twin Fists, Exagryph — and rail/railgun if listed separately in your build.

achievements.name: Friends in High Places
achievements.description: Use Greater Call to invoke an Olympian's aid

steps: Equip a boon that grants a Greater Call (God Gauge ability).
Fill the God Gauge in combat, then activate the Call to summon that Olympian’s aid.
Clear Elysium chambers and defeat Theseus & Asterius in the stadium.
You then enter Temple of Styx toward the final escape.
Gift Nectar to underworld residents listed on the prophecy (Skelly, Cerberus, Hypnos, etc.).
Claim “Chthonic Colleagues” on the Fated List when it completes.
Complete a full escape attempt — defeat [Redacted] / clear the final boss for the first time.

achievements.name: Death Dealer
achievements.description: Beat Thanatos by 15 kills or more

steps: When Thanatos appears mid-run for a kill contest, focus on clearing enemies faster than he does.
Win the contest by 15 kills or more before the encounter ends.
In the House courtyard, attack the Skelly training dummy until he “dies”.
Repeat across visits until you have slain him 15 times (progress is cumulative).

achievements.name: Well Stocked
achievements.description: Buy 9 'Well of Charon' items in one escape attempt

steps: In a single escape attempt, buy 9 different items from Wells of Charon (the mid-run shops).
In the House, interact with Cerberus to pet him (when the prompt appears).
Do this across visits until you reach 10 pets.

achievements.name: Day-or-Night Trader
achievements.description: Trade 20 times with the Wretched Broker

steps: Visit the Wretched Broker in the House lounge and trade resources (Darkness, Gems, Nectar, etc.).
Complete 20 separate trades — any Broker exchange counts.

achievements.name: Back to Work
achievements.description: Earn access to and enter the Administrative Chamber

steps: Progress Nyx / House story conversations until the Administrative Chamber unlocks.
Enter the chamber behind the House (west side / Nyx’s work area) once access is granted.
Across many runs, pick up Olympian boon rooms and choose different boon effects.
Aim for rarity variety and every god — 100 unique boon effects total (Codex / memory helps track novelty).
Spend Titan Blood at a weapon’s Aspect screen to upgrade one Aspect.
Raise any single Aspect to its maximum rank (usually rank 5).
Gift Nectar to Orpheus and progress his story with Nyx / House conversations.
Continue until Orpheus resumes singing in the House lounge.

achievements.name: Grown Close
achievements.description: Forge a bond with any character

steps: Gift Nectar to a character until you unlock their Keepsake.
Continue gifting Ambrosia / deepening the relationship until you forge a bond (heart / companion path).

achievements.name: River Denizens
achievements.description: Catch a fish from each region

steps: Buy the Fishing Rod from the House Contractor.
Catch at least one fish in Tartarus, Asphodel, Elysium, Styx, and surface/other listed regions.

achievements.name: Home Makeover
achievements.description: Pay for 50 jobs from the House Contractor

steps: Earn Gemstones from runs and spend them at the House Contractor board.
Purchase 50 separate Contractor jobs (decor, quality-of-life, fishing rod, etc.).

achievements.name: The Family Secret
achievements.description: Complete the main quest in the story

steps: Escape the Underworld and finish the main story quest beats with Persephone.
Keep talking to characters between runs after your first clear.
Buy items from Charon’s shops during runs (Wells and Charon shop rooms).
After enough purchases, Charon awards a Loyalty Card — equip/claim it when offered.
In the House of Hades, open the prophecy board (Minor Prophecies).
Complete and claim any 15 prophecies from that board.
In Daedalus Hammer rooms, pick different weapon enchantments across runs.
Collect 50 unique Hammer upgrades — try every Infernal Arm to widen the pool.
Deepen a bond with a character who grants a Chthonic Companion (Ambrosia path).
Equip the Companion from the Keepsake / Companion display before a run.
Unlock each Infernal Arm from the courtyard weapon stands.
Claim the “Master of Arms” prophecy on the Fated List.

achievements.name: Weapon of Fate
achievements.description: Clear an escape attempt with a hidden Weapon Aspect

steps: Unlock a hidden Aspect (requires specific NPC dialogue + Titan Blood — e.g. Aspect of Arthur, Lucifer, Gilgamesh, etc.).
Equip that hidden Aspect and clear a full escape (defeat [Redacted]).
Gift Nectar to each character who grants a standard Keepsake.
Collect every standard Keepsake at least once.

achievements.name: Hold the Onions
achievements.description: Clear an Infernal Gate without taking damage

steps: Enter an Infernal Gate (chaos gate style challenge room).
Clear it without taking any damage.

achievements.name: Well Versed
achievements.description: Fully Unlock the Olympians' Codex entries

steps: Meet each Olympian through boons and exhaust their Codex entry requirements (repeated meetings / story beats).
Fully unlock every Olympian entry in the Codex.
Take Ares boons and defeat the number of enemies the prophecy requires with his aid.
Claim “War-God’s Bloodlust” from the Fated List.

achievements.name: Champion of Elysium
achievements.description: Clear Elysium with the 'Extreme Measures' Condition

steps: Enable the Pact 'Extreme Measures' condition.
Clear Elysium (beat the EM-empowered Theseus & Asterius) with that condition active.
Progress Orpheus and Eurydice’s storylines (gifts + post-clear conversations).
Claim the “Musician and Muse” prophecy once their reunion path completes.

achievements.name: Haste of Hermes
achievements.description: Get 20% dodge chance with the Lambent Plume

steps: Obtain Hermes’ Lambent Plume keepsake (gift Nectar to Hermes).
Equip it and clear consecutive chambers without taking damage to stack dodge until you reach 20% dodge chance.

achievements.name: Bad Call
achievements.description: Use an Olympian's Greater Call against them in a Trial

steps: Enter a Trial of the Gods chamber where two Olympians compete.
Fill your God Gauge with one god’s Call, then use that Greater Call while fighting the other god’s champions.

achievements.name: The Useless Trinket
achievements.description: Earn the first of Skelly's prizes

steps: Check Skelly’s statue objectives in the courtyard.
Meet the first prize requirement (often a clear with a certain weapon or condition) and claim his first prize.
Obtain a Legendary boon during a run.
Visit a Purge / sell fountain (or equivalent remove-boon well) and purge that Legendary boon.
Open “Slashed Benefits” on the Fated List.
Meet its Pact / Mirror conditions as written, clear the requirement, then claim it.

achievements.name: Nyx's Mirror
achievements.description: Have at least one rank in each Mirror of Night Talent

steps: Unlock Mirror of Night talents with Darkness (and keys for the second side if needed).
Put at least 1 rank into every talent on both Mirror sides.
Progress Nyx and Chaos storylines (gifts, dialogue after clears).
Claim “Night and Darkness” when the Fated List marks it complete.
Progress Sisyphus / Bouldy story gifts and related prophecies.
Claim “End to Torment” from the Fated List when finished.
Spend Titan Blood at the House Contractor / weapon aspects screen.
Unlock every Weapon Aspect across all Infernal Arms.
Fulfill “Dark Reflections” on the Fated List (typically Mirror of Night investment goals).
Claim it once every listed talent requirement is met.
Progress Zagreus / Thanatos relationship and related combat meetings.
Claim “Divided by Death” from the Fated List when the story requirements complete.

achievements.name: One for the Ages
achievements.description: Reach the epilogue of the story

steps: Continue story conversations after the main ending until the epilogue triggers.
Requires multiple post-clear runs and gift/talk progress with key characters.
Enable multiple Pact of Punishment conditions and clear runs as the prophecy requires.
Claim “Harsh Conditions” from the Fated List.

achievements.name: Skelly's Last Lamentations
achievements.description: Earn the second of Skelly's prizes

steps: Meet Skelly's challenge goals in the courtyard to earn his second prize.
Check the Skelly statue objectives between runs.

achievements.name: Thorn of Thanatos
achievements.description: Get 30% bonus damage with the Pierced Butterfly

steps: Obtain Thanatos’ Pierced Butterfly keepsake (gift Nectar to Thanatos).
Equip it and clear consecutive chambers without taking damage until bonus damage reaches 30%.
Earn every Chthonic Companion through story/heart progress with the related characters.
Raise every standard Keepsake to max rank by clearing encounters while it is equipped.
Unequip when maxed and rotate — companions/keepsakes from DLC rules follow the in-game list of “standard” keepsakes.
